findings.title: The hook discards unresolved native cleanup ownership after Map retirement
findings.detail: dispose now honestly returns {complete, remainingIds}, but effect cleanup still voids it. A terminal remove failure leaves native pins held with no reachable business retry owner after replacement/unmount. The current low-level coordinator can recover when retained and dispose is retried; hook does not hand that responsibility onward.
findings.consequence: Repeated failed retirements can exhaust eight raster file slots and reject later useful imagery; this does not prove unbounded native/GPU memory growth or explain the Sky crash.
findings.requiredRepair: Retain the exact retired Map/coordinator ownership and resolve cleanup through a valid old-instance operation or verified destruction boundary; do not release pins solely on JS cleanup/generation change.
